name: submission-package-coach
description: Token-efficient, human-controlled academic revision prompts for submission packages.

interface.shortDescription: Audit papers and submission packages without losing your voice.
interface.longDescription: Routes academic revision tasks to compact, evidence-bound prompts. It starts with author-controlled audit reports, supports optional mentor-style rules, and escalates to installed specialist skills only when needed.
